predictions.text: I predict that more towns and areas in Tigray will be recaptured by Ethiopian federal forces, with Mekelle being fully secured and stabilized by the end of Tuesday, 13 October 2026.

I predict that the conflict in South Kordofan and North Kordofan will continue with at least one more airstrike reported, likely involving Sudan's armed forces and the Rapid Support Forces, resulting in civilian casualties.
I predict that the 25-year-old suspect will be charged with terrorism offenses by the end of Tuesday, 13 October 2026, and the charges will include preparation for terrorist acts.
I predict that the Bab al-Mandab Strait and surrounding areas will remain under Houthi control, with Saudi Arabia continuing its offensives to regain control.
I predict that the investigation into the 2026 Vienna, Georgia, shooting will continue, with law enforcement interviewing witnesses and reviewing surveillance footage in Vienna, Georgia.
I predict that the United States will conduct at least one additional airstrike and make several more arrests in the Caribbean Sea region by the end of Tuesday, 13 October 2026.
